name: @stillfail/station
description: The still.fail station in TypeScript; its native parts in native/

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts src/read/worker.ts src/read/said-worker.ts src/read/recent-chat-worker.ts src/read/session-list-worker.ts src/read/session-bindings-worker.ts src/read/session-up-jobs-worker.ts src/read/workspace-up-jobs-worker.ts src/read/widget-sources-worker.ts src/read/cc-index-worker.ts src/read/card-posts-worker.ts src/read/archive-mark-worker.ts src/search/worker.ts src/search/scope-worker.ts src/vault/use-index-worker.ts src/vault/signin-save-worker.ts src/usage/minute-worker.ts src/usage/retire-worker.ts src/usage/scope-worker.ts src/sessions/live-locator-worker.ts src/sessions/workspace-activity-worker.ts src/sessions/session-count-worker.ts src/sessions/post-block-worker.ts src/read/chat-index-worker.ts src/replica/worker.ts src/replica/restore-worker.ts src/replica/carry-worker.ts --outbase=src --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outdir=dist --external:*.node --banner:js="import { createRequire as __bundleCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __bundleCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && mkdir -p dist/skills && cp -R src/skills/. dist/skills/ && cp src/agents/dsh-bridge.mjs src/agents/cursor-bridge.mjs src/agents/sandbox-bridge.mjs src/agents/repo-rules-hook.mjs src/screens/linux-portal.py src/screens/linux-x11.py src/screens/scrcpy-server dist/
scripts.test: node ../scripts/native.ts run mesh runner archive-rs reader -- node --import ./test/setup-env.mjs --test --test-timeout=600000 test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:side: node ../scripts/native.ts run mesh runner archive-rs reader -- node --import ./test/setup-env.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 side/*.test.ts
